normalization: lowercase ASCII alphanumeric words via [a-z0-9]+; concatenate published text_ref or transcript segments; unigrams preserve speaker/caption words; exact ordered unique word 5-gram and 10-gram sets
metrics: Jaccard=shared5/union5; shorter containment=shared5/min(set sizes). 10gram intersection is a stricter crosscheck. No MinHash approximation.
limits: Text-only screen; no pairwise audio or video fingerprints
Captions/transcript availability and wording differ; low overlap does not mathematically rule out audiovisual reuploads
Unrelated generic lecture phrases and speaker cues can cause small overlaps
This is exclusion screening, not GT validation or model selection
